title: Customer Order Frequency
scenario: Find the average number of orders per customer. Return the result as 'avg_order_count'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Count orders per customer, then take the average of those counts.
correctQuery: SELECT AVG(cnt)::NUMERIC AS avg_order_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(delivery_id) AS cnt FROM delivery GROUP BY customer_id) t;
